summary: IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas deputy commander Abd al-Rahim Kardi in a Gaza City airstrike Thursday; he participated in the October 7 invasion and held hostages Romi Gonen and Cpl. Noa Marciano. An IDF combat officer was moderately wounded during operational activity in southern Lebanon overnight Saturday. The US EUCOM commander warned the Pentagon that only two warships in the Eastern Mediterranean and one in the Red Sea are insufficient to defend Israel against ballistic missile attacks.
